item.text: [{"task_id":"45bbe264","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    crossing = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    threshold = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    row_axis = int(round(params['rule'][3]))","    col_axis = int(round(params['rule'][4]))","    if row_axis != 0 or col_axis != 1:","        return grid.copy()","    rows = np.arange(grid.shape[row_axis]).reshape((-1, 1))","    cols = np.arange(grid.shape[col_axis]).reshape((1, -1))","    output = np.full(grid.shape, background, dtype=int)","    counts = np.zeros(grid.shape, dtype=int)","    for position in np.argwhere(grid != background):","        r, c = position","        mask = np.logical_or(rows == r, cols == c)","        output = np.where(mask, grid[r, c], output)","        counts = counts + mask","    return np.where(counts > threshold, crossing, output)"],"shapes":{"rule":[5]},"params":{"rule":[0,2,1,0,1]},"rationale":"Extend each nonbackground seed across its entire row and column in its original color.
